艺术宫看什么，哪些需要买票: What to see, and what needs a ticket
这处地标源于 1915 年巴拿马太平洋万国博览会，今天吸引人的重点是圆顶、柱廊和: The landmark originated with the 1915 Panama-Pacific International Exposition. Its dome, colonnades and artificial lagoon shape the outdoor experience today. Ordinary visits to the public grounds are free; wedding reservation fees on the city website are not per-person admission. Performances at the Palace of Fine Arts Theatre require separate tickets, while food and parking are additional costs. Seeing the rotunda does not include every indoor event.
湖边、柱廊、海滨三段慢走: Three relaxed segments: lagoon, colonnades and waterfront
路线为编辑建议，以公开步道和过街口连接。每段都可单独完成；遇活动围挡或工程就缩短: This editorial route uses public paths and crossings. Each segment works on its own; shorten it for event barriers or construction instead of cutting through parking traffic.
先从湖岸看完整圆顶，沿开放步道找座位，不攀越湖边围护。: Start with a full view of the dome from the lagoon shore. Look for seating along open paths without climbing barriers.
走近看柱式与光影，遇婚礼或拍摄给对方留空间。: Look at columns and changing light up close, giving weddings and photography groups room.
由正规路口往 Yacht Road 与 Marina Boulevard 一带走: Use proper crossings toward Yacht Road and Marina Boulevard, and check restroom availability.
风小就短走海滨，想吃饭则转往 Chestnut 商业街，二选一即可。: Take a short waterfront walk in mild wind, or head to Chestnut Street for a meal; choosing one is enough.
拍建筑，也照顾使用这个公园的人: Photograph the architecture while sharing the park
同一处圆顶可以从湖对岸、柱廊侧面和树荫下看，不必把每张照片都拍成站在正中央的合影: View the dome from across the lagoon, beside a colonnade and under the trees rather than taking every photo from the central axis. A wedding reservation is not an invitation to step into the ceremony for a shot; follow staff directions and go around setups. Watch waterbirds from the bank without chasing or feeding them, and keep children from treating the lagoon as a play pool.
Marina 海边更开阔，也更容易受风影响。不要预先承诺一定能看清远处岛屿或大桥: The Marina waterfront is more exposed to wind. Do not promise clear views of distant islands or the bridge; on a foggy day, focus on architecture around the lagoon. With a stroller or wheelchair, check the entrance, surfaces and crossing distances you plan to use. General park access does not mean every photo spot is easy to reach.
先确认想看的是户外艺术宫还是剧院演出，订票入口不要混淆。: Decide whether you want the outdoor Palace or a theater performance, and use the appropriate booking information.
带防风衣、水和少量点心，用餐后把垃圾带离湖边。: Bring a wind layer, water and a small snack, and remove litter after eating.
停车看现场时限和收费；市政府活动场地页面的费用不是停车价格。: Read on-site parking limits and charges; event-space fees on city pages are not parking prices.
出发前看 Marina 项目更新，约定体力不足或起风时从哪一站结束。: Check Marina project updates and agree where to finish if someone tires or the wind rises.
